sentinel_knowledge_base.detected_issue: Closed trades displaying exit ROI instead of peak excursion.
sentinel_knowledge_base.root_cause: Database default in close_position_in_db fell back to realized PnL.
sentinel_knowledge_base.resolution_applied: Enforced milestone baseline guarantee (Fee Shield requires MFE >= 4.80%) and direct peak excursion passing.
sentinel_knowledge_base.lesson_learned: Never allow trade closing logic to overwrite historical candle peak with final exit tick.

sentinel_knowledge_base.detected_issue: Sub-cent coin prices displayed as $0.0046 -> $0.0046 due to 4-decimal truncation.
sentinel_knowledge_base.root_cause: Standard toFixed(4) formatting is too coarse for coins trading under $0.01.
sentinel_knowledge_base.resolution_applied: Implemented dynamic precision formatCoinPrice (6-7 decimals for sub-cent assets).
sentinel_knowledge_base.lesson_learned: Always scale decimal precision dynamically based on asset spot price magnitude.

sentinel_knowledge_base.detected_issue: Micro-OB setups had tight 0.4% TP targets that exited trades in 30 seconds.
sentinel_knowledge_base.root_cause: Fixed 3R Take Profit formula on ultra-small Order Block wicks limits runner potential.
sentinel_knowledge_base.resolution_applied: Disabled fixed TP cap completely, letting trades ride infinitely via Stepped Trailing SL.
sentinel_knowledge_base.lesson_learned: Let compounding trades ride momentum indefinitely until Trailing SL locks profit.

sentinel_knowledge_base.detected_issue: Trades opened on Render cloud without sending Telegram alerts.
sentinel_knowledge_base.root_cause: Telegram bot was only configured in local runner rather than cloud sniper engine.
sentinel_knowledge_base.resolution_applied: Directly integrated Telegram Bot (@SMC_1H_Trigger_Bot) with strict 2-alert discipline.
sentinel_knowledge_base.lesson_learned: Cloud backend must dispatch Alert 1 (Entry Filled) and Alert 2 (Closed) autonomously.

sentinel_knowledge_base.detected_issue: Section equity drift from rapid loop churn or phantom re-entries.
sentinel_knowledge_base.root_cause: Lack of atomic reconciliation across SQLite positions and Deca sections ledger.
sentinel_knowledge_base.resolution_applied: Implemented purge_phantom_churn_trades and reconcile_sections_ledger.
sentinel_knowledge_base.lesson_learned: Always anchor Deca section balance to Starting Balance + sum(Realized Net PnL).

sentinel_knowledge_base.detected_issue: Position had residual fixed TP target of $1.5562.
sentinel_knowledge_base.root_cause: Legacy order template or test payload.
sentinel_knowledge_base.resolution_applied: Reset tp_price to 0.0 for pure infinite stepped trailing mode.
sentinel_knowledge_base.lesson_learned: Pure Trailing SL mode strictly prohibits fixed take-profit caps.

sentinel_knowledge_base.detected_issue: Position reached +5.31% ROI peak but was at Tier 0 (SL: $1.6442).
sentinel_knowledge_base.root_cause: Tick execution loop slight timing delta before milestone promotion.
sentinel_knowledge_base.resolution_applied: Auto-promoted RENDERUSDT to Tier 1 (Locked +1.0% ROI | SL ➔ $1.5978).
sentinel_knowledge_base.lesson_learned: Sentinel guarantees trailing stop progression even if candle spikes between tick cycles.
